independence.mutations: Only this challenge-a.json was authored. No precursor, receipt, ciphertext, candidate, active grammar, production, or forbidden path was modified.

findings: The consuming-number seam is the right kind of primitive for the direct-combinator reset: it owns CSS Syntax section 4.3.13 as one prefix-consuming value-unit operation and introduces no token, atom, CST, lexer, scanner, cursor, or source-slicing runtime.

The frozen authority set is internally non-admitting. FEATURE-LEDGER.md is explicitly BORN-RED and calls the rows proposed rather than sealed; it also states that SYNTAX-CONSUME-NUMBER follows only after SYNTAX-NUMBER-START is accepted. The same G5 authority registry binds syntax-number-start/g7/rejection.json, so no accepted prerequisite exists in the exact subject.

The exact G5 manifest vocabulary cannot cure that conflict: its required closure is limited to the 14 frozen precursors, the holdout pair, two reviews, and root gestalt. It has no row for a subsequently accepted denominator, a sealed occurrence-to-owner feature row, or an authority that changes the rejected number-start dependency.
Accordingly this generation cannot truthfully issue AUTHORS_MAY_BE_INVITED, even though its narrow grammar language is sound.

The accepted-prefix language, maximal dot/exponent guards, integer/number type rule, sign rule, Object.is binary64 observation, exact ordinary three-key leaf, and same-input UTF-16 extent observation agree with the pinned CSS Syntax algorithm and the declared ECMAScript carrier boundary.

An independent clause transcription matched the declared regex on all 299593 strings of lengths zero through six over +-.eE09x. Public fixtures cover the six true number-start arms, nonzero offsets, incomplete fraction/exponent tails, composition witnesses, and four 32768-character hostile constructions.

The failure contract is not complete enough to be a frozen parse-that operation contract. It says only fail without consumption and emit no public API diagnostic object; it does not say whether the predecessor value, furthest, expected, suggestions, and secondarySpans must be preserved, cleared, or extended. The public harness creates predecessor values but on failure checks only isError and offset. Hidden state-invariance labels cannot add a public semantic rule after authoring.

The claimed work-limit evidence has no limit. Neither the feature boundary nor the harness declares a step, time, stack, allocation, or asymptotic bound; direct invocation of a 32768-character case proves only termination if the surrounding process eventually returns.
No candidate exists, so no candidate receives correctness, idiom, performance, or feature credit.

H, B, S, and D are plausible design labels, but the author-admission gate does not establish operative topology or orthogonal provenance. Its AST visitor counts calls anywhere in a source file and never proves that the counted any/all/string/dispatch nodes are reachable from the exported consumeNumber initializer. B, S, and D can therefore carry dead topology-shaped declarations while exporting the same operative whole-regex parser as H; distinct file hashes can arise solely from the dead declarations.

No content-addressed historical H source, provenance graph, H/B genealogy finding, or pairwise construction review is part of the frozen cell. The fourth D seat is useful insurance, but it does not replace the owner-ratified pre-author provenance record.

The pre-author verdict checker admits structurally trivial ACCEPT JSON. It checks only feature_id, generation, review_id, scope, and verdict, and checks only the root challenge hash list. It does not require reviewer identities, pairwise independence, model receipts, the three-altitude rubric, evidence, defects, or credit. Thus two fabricated nominal ACCEPT files and a nominal root file satisfy the executable admission condition without two substantive independent challenges.

The five-skeptic and three-adjudicator role names are stated correctly and the deferred contract requires unanimity on one reviewed candidate hash. This is retained design text only; it cannot repair the pre-author gate defects above.

The four-seat Williams order, fixed warmup and measured rounds, fixed batching, retained O(1) observation fold, paired log-ratio statistic, shared-index bootstrap maximum, and conservative four-candidate familywise percentile are coherent as a candidate-only timing experiment.

The timing experiment is not correctness-qualified. It accepts a corpus containing only id/source/offset and preflights only equality of the four candidate digests. Four identically wrong implementations pass; no expected normalized result or previously green public/holdout receipt is an input to the runner.

The self-contained bundle is not cryptographically joined to the four admitted source hashes, author receipts, or a reproducible build ledger. The runner can time arbitrary objects named h/b/s/d, so its winner cannot be attributed to the admitted candidate set.

The sole benchmark procedure contains only H/B/S/D. It does not identify or measure the LIVE regex comparator or retained prior parse-that iterations required by the owner-ratified peer-beating law, and it has no explicit NON_COMPARABLE classifications.

The runner does not seal a pre-timing run manifest or immutable append-only raw-result path, enforce attempt retirement, record median plus dispersion, or validate its emitted receipt against the schema. The no-retry rule is a string, not an executable lifecycle constraint.
